title: dispositions.jsonl row (what was decided about one finding)
description: One row per disposed finding under .dabbler/runs/<set>/s<N>/critique/<change-id>/dispositions.jsonl, appended only by router commands after validation. Safety/data-loss, boundary/auth, and exposed-contract findings are designated classes: accepting one rather than fixing it requires recorded human approval, and the schema refuses the row without it. A disposition is a record of a decision already taken through the router, never a channel for supplying a verdict by hand.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the row rather than interpreting it.

human_approval.description: Recorded by the router at an interactive prompt. Its presence in a file is not self-certifying; the writer validates before it is ever written.
